How it works

A person typing, from the site's side.

A chat site has no tool-calling API, so tools are a convention written into the conversation. CloseNI teaches the model that convention and runs what comes back.

  1. 1
    Open

    A Chromium window with your own session. You sign in once, in the real site.

  2. 2
    Ask

    Your request goes into the chat box, with the project's context and the tool conventions the model needs.

  3. 3
    Read

    It waits for the stream to end, parses the reply into tool calls, and runs the ones you allow.

  4. 4
    Check

    Tests, type checks and the build run on the result. A failure goes back to the model as the next prompt.

Features

What it does

Everything here is covered by the test suites linked from the docs. Where something is not, the docs say so.

No API key

It opens a real Chromium window with the session you are signed into, types the prompt, waits for the reply to finish streaming and reads it back. From the site's side it is a person typing.

A coding agent

Reads and searches the project, edits files, runs commands and checks its work. File changes and commands ask first, as diffs you can read.

Plan, build, repair

For a larger job it plans, you revise the plan, and each step is built, checked and repaired before the next one starts.

Twelve languages

It picks the checks that fit the project: tests, type checks, a build, whichever the project actually has.

Safe by default

Writes stay inside the workspace, secret files are never read without asking, and every command can be refused. Read the safety model before you give it autonomy.

Eleven themes

Terminal, Paper, Cassette, Phosphor and seven more. Light or dark, same layout.

Download

Get CloseNI

Version 0.1. A native Qt app with Node and the agent bundled. Chromium is downloaded on first run.

Windows

NSIS installer; you choose the folder. Windows 10 or later.

Download the .exe

macOS

Disk images for Apple silicon and Intel.

Download the .dmg

Linux

An AppImage that runs anywhere, or a .deb for Debian and Ubuntu.

Download AppImage or .deb

From source

Node 22, Qt 6.8 or later, CMake and Ninja.

git clone https://github.com/siddarth1872004/CloseNI.git && cd CloseNI
npm install && npm run build
npx playwright install chromium
cmake -S native -B build-native -G Ninja
cmake --build build-native && npm start
The installers are unsigned. Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper will warn the first time; that warning is accurate. The first run asks you to install Chromium and sign in to a provider once.
